data.current_summary: Analyze a recipe → per-line resolution + per-serving/per-100 g nutrition + source attribution + review flags.
data.summary_suggestion: Analyze recipe ingredients and calculate nutrition facts
data.description_suggestion: Analyzes a recipe by parsing raw ingredient lines and calculating comprehensive nutrition information. Supports ingredients from USDA FoodData Central, McCance & Widdowson's CoFID, ANSES Ciqual, Danish Food Composition Database, FSANZ AUSNUT, and Open Food Facts.
